items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I hung out with him a while. He told me a lot...

ctx.x: So Buster said finally, "Go get your horn," and they went in the joint and they blew it all night. And Blue was a virtuoso. He'd come out of St. Louis. His father had the Imperial Band. I hung out with him a while. He told me a lot...
